acts.title: The Bait
acts.goal: Open on the public humiliation, ground Elena's place in the household and her mother's death, then detonate the sealed tack room and the deed with June Vance's name.
acts.cliffhanger: THE DEED WAS BURIED WITH HER

acts.title: The Trap
acts.goal: The system closes around Elena: the county refuses her standing, Victoria offers a silence deal, and a Friday-midnight deadline turns the ranch into a cage.

acts.title: The First Crack
acts.goal: Elena stops defending and starts digging: the two deeds prove the second sale was signed by a dead woman, and a first honest moment with Cole raises the stakes.
acts.cliffhanger: TAKE THE MONEY. LEAVE THE NAME.

acts.title: The Dark Night
acts.goal: Rejecting the deal costs Elena her freedom and the tin box; Maggie's old lie is explained, and a dead woman's deposit slip turns the brass key into the way out.
acts.cliffhanger: THE KEY WAS NEVER FOR A DOOR

acts.title: The Turn

acts.cliffhanger: ONE NIGHT TO BURN THE TRUTH

acts.title: The Payoff
acts.goal: At the county hearing the will is read in public, the mask comes off, and Silver Creek changes hands; a line in Walter's letter opens the next mystery.
acts.cliffhanger: THE WILL NAMES A SECOND HEIR

teasers.caption:
She cleaned their house for twelve years.

But the barn keeps what this family buried.

Whose name is on the deed under the floor? Follow for Episode 2.

teasers.title: The Twist

She refused their half-million dollar bribe.

Now the county sheriff is tearing down her door.

What did her mother hide in the vault? Follow for Episode 2.

teasers.title: The Cliffhanger
teasers.hook_text: THE WILL NAMES A SECOND HEIR
teasers.caption:
They stole her mother's life and twenty years of dignity.

Now she owns every acre of their Montana dynasty.

Who is the second heir? Follow for Episode 2.
